claim: A searched representation can make held-out synthetic problem families materially easier for a fixed simple downstream learner than the raw representation, after representation-search overhead is explicitly counted.
scopeBoundary: does not establish a new mathematics or ontology
does not establish cross-domain scientific usefulness

split.selectionRule: Choose representation/model by validation accuracy, then lower evaluation burden, then lexical representation id. Held-out test is never used for selection.

falsifier: Fewer than three preregistered task families achieve both >=0.95 held-out accuracy and >=0.20 absolute held-out accuracy improvement over the raw baseline, or the search accidentally uses held-out labels for selection.
promotionBoundary: A pass may support SOFTWARE_DEMONSTRATED for this narrow representation-search mechanism only after review; it cannot promote the grand Ontological Computing moonshot by itself.
